subject: HelioCare POC orchestration — success criteria, owners, and exec decision cadence
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@heliocare.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Redwood POC scoping + next steps

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. High-level recap from our side: HelioCare is prioritizing a two-week POC focused on triage-assist for our intake team (English-only, up to 8k tokens/session). The outcomes we care about are: 1) classification accuracy for 6 priority chief complaints, 2) average latency under 350ms at 1 concurrent request, and 3) no PHI retention beyond session (audit capability required).

Action items we flagged on the call:
- Redwood to propose a concrete evaluation plan and ownership matrix
- Share an initial timeline and any required credentials forward (service account, firewall IPs)
- Security questionnaire — I attached the notes we took (HelioCare-Roadmap-Notes.pdf)

Can you put together a one-page POC plan with owners and proposed dates? We'd like to have the POC start the week of Aug 17 if possible; final executive readout target week of Aug 31 - the exec committee will need a short decision packet.

Thanks,
Maria
Director, Clinical Innovations
HelioCare

---
Attachment: HelioCare-Roadmap-Notes.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@heliocare.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood POC scoping + next steps

Maria — appreciate the clear recap and the notes. Per your ask, attached is a concise POC proposal (RC_POC_Proposal_v1.pdf). Key highlights below:

POC objective (2 weeks):
- Validate triage-assist intent classification on 6 chief complaints (precision >= 0.88 on curated eval set)
- Meet median token latency <= 320ms at target concurrency (1–2 concurrent by default, burst to 5)
- Confirm zero-persist policy: KV cache ephemeral; audit log streaming to your S3 for session correlation

Success criteria / acceptance gates:
- Data: 300 labeled examples per complaint for gating (we can augment if needed)
- Metrics: precision, recall, avg latency, false-positive rate for sensitive PHI flags
- Ops: runbook executed for two simulated outage scenarios; automatic fallback to smaller model with degraded SLA noted

Owners / roles (Day 0 = POC start):
- HelioCare lead: Maria Gomez — validation datasets & procurement sign-off
- Redwood engineers: Priya Natarajan — POC PM/technical lead; Aditya Rao — runtime & infra lead
- Redwood solutions: Priyom Das — success criteria instrumentation + exec readout prep

Proposed timeline (calendar view):
- Aug 17 — Day 0: environment prep, access provisioning, security checklist
- Aug 18–21 — baseline ingest + calibration; synthetic augmentation if short on labeled examples
- Aug 24–28 — evaluation window (metrics collection, performance/latency sweeps)
- Aug 31 — executive readout (30–45m) and go/no-go decision

Immediate asks from HelioCare:
1) Confirm ability to provide the labeled subset (even 50% initially) by Aug 13
2) Service account + IP allowlist for Redwood (we'll provide precise list)
3) Point person for procurement (contract signature and billing)

Notes on attachments: RC_POC_Proposal_v1.pdf contains the evaluation checklist and a simple runbook. I also included a short appendix on quantization tradeoffs if you want to trade throughput for cost during the evaluation.

If these owners and dates work, can we lock in the exec readout slot the week of Aug 31? Priyom — can you own the readout deck and capture the go/no-go criteria in the one-pager?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood POC scoping + next steps

Looping in Laura for the exec scheduling and procurement path. Quick internal note on the decision process and what we should prepare for the readout:

Decision packet (to be ready by Aug 28):
- One-page TL;DR of outcomes vs. acceptance gates (Priyom)
- Key metrics sheet (Aditya) showing confusion matrix / latency percentiles and cost per 1k tokens
- Security sign-off checklist (Priya) + a link to the completed HelioCare questionnaire
- Proposed contract change summary (Laura) — standard MSA + 90-day pilot addendum; if they want reserved capacity we'll surface pricing options

Decision makers: Maria (Clinical), Daniel Thompson (Procurement), CTO (TBD)
Go/no-go rubric (suggested):
- Green: success criteria met; procurement ready; no unresolved security gaps
- Yellow: one non-critical metric missed OR procurement needs minor redlines — recommend 30-day extended pilot with mitigations
- Red: critical metric failure OR outstanding security/compliance blockers — stop and iterate

Laura — can you coordinate a 30–45 minute exec slot in the week of Aug 31 (preferably Tue/Wed morning PT)? Also track the procurement contact (Daniel) so we can route the DocuSign packet quickly.

— Priyom
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
